description: The bar chart, Figure 3, illustrates the distribution of datasets by year, categorized into "Targeted" and "Untargeted" datasets. The horizontal axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022, with labels at every year. The vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 160, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The chart features stacked bars, with "Targeted" datasets represented in orange and "Untargeted" datasets in blue. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and the height of the bars varies across the years. The "Targeted" datasets are consistently more numerous than the "Untargeted" ones, with the orange portion of the bars increasing significantly from 2019 onwards, reaching a maximum value of approximately 145 in 2021. The "Untargeted" datasets, represented by the blue portion, remain relatively low, with a maximum value of around 80 in 2021. The data for 2022 is partially available, as indicated in the caption.
